title: Add or remove a robot from the Robot Selection tab using robot ID or selection
summary: On the Robot Selection tab in the OptiSweep HMI/web UI, add a robot by entering its robot ID and clicking "Add" (or remove it by entering the robot ID or selecting the robot and clicking "Remove"). The system provides explicit success indications; if the robot is already present, the system does not change.
when_to_use: Use when you need to ensure a robot is logically present in the system model by adding it via robot ID, or when you need to remove a robot via robot ID or by selecting it in the Robot Selection tab, and you must confirm the system reports success.
roles_and_responsibilities: Operator: Perform the add/remove action in the Robot Selection tab and verify the on-screen success indication.
safety_notes: Removing a robot can create a mismatch where a physical robot remains on the floor while the system no longer has a logical robot entry.
access_or_tools_needed: Access to the HMI/web UI Robot Selection tab
Robot ID values for the target robot
Ability to click/select a robot on the Robot Selection tab

access_required: HMI/web UI access to the Robot Selection tab
system_preconditions: Robot Selection tab is available in the HMI/web UI

visual_references.description: Robot Selection Add/Remove UI frame showing robot ID entry, "Add" and "Remove" controls, and the success indication text.

steps.title: Open the Robot Selection tab in the HMI/web UI
steps.purpose: Access the UI controls needed to add or remove a robot by robot ID or selection.
steps.instruction: Open the Robot Selection tab in the OptiSweep HMI/web UI.
steps.expected_result: The Robot Selection tab is visible and ready for input (robot ID field and Add/Remove controls are accessible).
steps.healthy_condition: You can see the Robot Selection tab controls used to add/remove robots (robot ID entry and Add/Remove actions).
steps.failure_condition: The Robot Selection tab is not accessible or the Add/Remove controls are not visible.

actions.label: Verify Robot Selection tab is open
actions.exact_action: Open the Robot Selection tab in the HMI/web UI.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Type the robot ID and click "Add" to add the robot; ... For removal, enter robot ID or click the robot and press "Remove".

steps.title: Add a robot by robot ID
steps.purpose: Ensure the robot is logically present in the system by adding it using its robot ID.
steps.instruction: Enter the corresponding robot ID in the robot ID field on the Robot Selection tab, then click the "Add" button.
steps.expected_result: The system displays the success indication "robot was added successfully" for the Add action. If the robot is already in the system, nothing changes.
steps.healthy_condition: A success indication appears after clicking "Add" ("robot was added successfully").
steps.failure_condition: No success indication appears after clicking "Add" (do not assume the robot was added).

actions.label: Enter robot ID
actions.exact_action: Enter the corresponding robot ID in the robot ID field.

stop_or_escalate_if: If the system does not show the expected success message after Add, stop and escalate for assistance.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Type the robot ID and click "Add" ... system will show that the robot was added successfully. If the robot is already in the system, nothing will happen.
OCR/slide text lists: 1) Enter corresponding robot ID 2) Click "Add" 3) System shows adding was successful.

steps.title: Verify Add result (including already-present behavior)
steps.purpose: Confirm the system reports success and that no unintended change occurs when the robot is already present.
steps.instruction: After clicking "Add", observe the system response message and confirm it indicates success (or indicates no change if the robot was already present).
steps.expected_result: You see "robot was added successfully" when the robot is added; if the robot is already in the system, nothing happens.
steps.healthy_condition: Success indication is shown for a new add; no change occurs when the robot already exists.
steps.failure_condition: The system response is missing/unclear or does not match the expected success indication.

actions.label: Check success indication
actions.exact_action: Verify the system shows an "adding" success message / "robot was added successfully" after Add.

stop_or_escalate_if: If the system does not show the expected success message after Add, stop and escalate for assistance.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: If the robot is already in the system, nothing will happen, but once it's added successfully, the system will show that the robot was added successfully.

steps.title: Remove a robot by robot ID or selection
steps.purpose: Remove the robot from the system model by entering its robot ID or selecting it in the Robot Selection tab and clicking "Remove".
steps.instruction: To remove: either enter the corresponding robot ID in the robot ID field OR click/select the robot on the tab, then click the "Remove" button.
steps.expected_result: The system displays the success indication "removal was successful" for the Remove action.
steps.healthy_condition: A success indication appears after clicking "Remove" ("removal was successful").
steps.failure_condition: No success indication appears after clicking "Remove" (do not assume the robot was removed).

actions.label: Enter robot ID (optional path)
actions.exact_action: Enter the corresponding robot ID in the robot ID field.

actions.label: Select robot (optional path)
actions.exact_action: Click/select the robot on the Robot Selection tab.

stop_or_escalate_if: If the system does not show the expected success message after Remove, stop and escalate for assistance (do not assume the robot was removed).

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: For removal, you can either type in the robot ID or you can click on a robot itself and press remove and it will show the removal was successful.
OCR/slide text lists: 1) Enter the corresponding robot Id or select the robot 2) Click "Remove" 3) System shows that the removal was successful.

steps.title: Verify Remove result and note logical vs physical mismatch risk
steps.purpose: Confirm the system reports successful removal and apply the operational caution that removal can leave a physical robot present without a logical robot entry.
steps.instruction: After clicking "Remove", verify the system shows "removal was successful". If you removed a robot while it is physically present on the floor, be aware that the system may no longer have a logical robot entry for it.
steps.expected_result: You see "removal was successful" after Remove. If the robot was physically present, you understand that the system model may no longer include a logical robot entry for it.
steps.healthy_condition: Removal success indication is shown; you have no ambiguity about whether the system accepted the removal.
steps.failure_condition: No removal success indication appears, or you proceed assuming removal occurred when the system did not confirm it.

actions.label: Check removal success indication
actions.exact_action: Verify the system shows a removal success message ("removal was successful").

stop_or_escalate_if: If the system does not show the expected success message after Remove, stop and escalate for assistance (do not assume the robot was removed).

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: If removal is successful, it will show the removal was successful.
You don't have a logical robot on the system, but you have a physical robot on the system.

success_criteria: After Add, the system displays "robot was added successfully" (or shows no change when the robot is already in the system).
After Remove, the system displays "removal was successful".
healthy_conditions: Robot add/remove actions produce explicit success indications in the Robot Selection tab UI.
When the robot is already present, the system does not change.
failure_conditions: After clicking "Add" or "Remove", the expected success message does not appear.
Proceeding with assumptions when the system did not confirm success.
escalation_guidance: If the system does not show the expected success message after Add/Remove, stop and escalate for assistance rather than assuming the robot was added/removed.

source_refs.quote_or_summary: Type the robot ID and click "Add" to add the robot; if already in the system, nothing happens; system shows "robot was added successfully". For removal, enter robot ID or click the robot and press "Remove"; system shows removal success.

missing_details: Exact UI label text for the robot ID field and the Add/Remove button placement is not fully specified beyond "robot ID field" and "Add"/"Remove" labels.
No explicit guidance is provided for what to do if the robot is already present beyond noting that nothing happens.
